### What are you really trying to do?

<!-- 
Tell us at a high level what you're doing, to avoid XY problem (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/XY_problem) 
-->

I'm using Nexus inside of workflows with a payload codec, and calling a Nexus operation without input arguments (`NoValue`) from within the workflow is failing.

### Describe the bug

<!-- A clear and concise description of what the bug is. -->

https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-dotnet/blob/1.14.0/src/Temporalio/Worker/WorkflowInstance.cs#L2587

```csharp
var cmd = new ScheduleNexusOperation()
                {
                    Seq = seq,
                    Endpoint = input.ClientOptions.Endpoint,
                    Service = input.Service,
                    Operation = input.OperationName,
                    Input = input.Arg == null ? null : payloadConverter.ToPayload(input.Arg),
                    CancellationType = (Bridge.Api.Nexus.NexusOperationCancellationType)input.Options.CancellationType,
                };
```
When the Nexus operation has no arguments, there is no payload, and the value of `Input` is `null`.

https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-dotnet/blob/1.14.0/src/Temporalio/Worker/WorkflowCodecHelper.cs#L336

When `Input` is `null`, the payload (or lack thereof) does not go through a payload codec.

This is asymmetric with the deserialization code path: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-dotnet/blob/1.14.0/src/Temporalio/Worker/NexusPayloadSerializer.cs#L58, where if a payload codec exists, the payload always goes through the payload codec.

I would think that most real world payload codec implementations don't support decoding a payload that wasn't encoded by the same payload codec.



<!-- If applicable, add screenshots or code blocks to help explain your problem. You can also use [Loom](http://loom.com/) to do short, free video bug reports. -->

```csharp
[NexusService]
public interface INoArgService
{
    [NexusOperation]
    string DoSomething();
}

[NexusServiceHandler(typeof(INoArgService))]
public class NoArgService
{
    [NexusOperationHandler]
    public IOperationHandler<NoValue, string> DoSomething() =>
        OperationHandler.Sync<NoValue, string>((ctx, _) => "hello");
}

[Fact]
public async Task ExecuteNexusOperationAsync_NoValueInputArgWithCodec_Succeeds()
{
    var newOptions = (TemporalClientOptions)Client.Options.Clone();
    newOptions.DataConverter = DataConverter.Default with
    {
        PayloadCodec = new Converters.Base64PayloadCodec(),
    };
    var codecClient = new TemporalClient(Client.Connection, newOptions);

    var workerOptions = new TemporalWorkerOptions($"tq-{Guid.NewGuid()}").
        AddNexusService(new NoArgService());
    var endpoint = await CreateNexusEndpointAsync(workerOptions.TaskQueue!);

    workerOptions = (TemporalWorkerOptions)workerOptions.Clone();
    workerOptions.Interceptors = new IWorkerInterceptor[] { new XunitExceptionInterceptor() };
    workerOptions.AddWorkflow(WorkflowDefinition.Create(
        typeof(CustomFuncWorkflow),
        null,
        _args => new CustomFuncWorkflow(async () =>
        {
            var result = await Workflow.CreateNexusWorkflowClient<INoArgService>(endpoint).
                ExecuteNexusOperationAsync(svc => svc.DoSomething());
            Assert.Equal("hello", result);
            return null;
        })));

    using var worker = new TemporalWorker(codecClient, workerOptions);
    await worker.ExecuteAsync(async () =>
    {
        var handle = await codecClient.StartWorkflowAsync(
            (CustomFuncWorkflow wf) => wf.RunAsync(),
            new($"wf-{Guid.NewGuid()}", workerOptions.TaskQueue!));
        await handle.GetResultAsync();
    });
}
```

### Environment/Versions

<!-- Please complete the following information where relevant. -->

- OS and processor: [e.g. M1 Mac, x86 Windows, Linux]
- Temporal Version: 1.14.0
- Are you using Docker or Kubernetes or building Temporal from source?

### Additional context

Because the payload is always being decoded when deserialized, it should likely always be encoded when serialized

```csharp
var cmd = new ScheduleNexusOperation()
                {
                    Seq = seq,
                    Endpoint = input.ClientOptions.Endpoint,
                    Service = input.Service,
                    Operation = input.OperationName,
                    Input = payloadConverter.ToPayload(input.Arg),
                    CancellationType = (Bridge.Api.Nexus.NexusOperationCancellationType)input.Options.CancellationType,
                };
```
